activation_rule: Explicit owner selection of GCL in context, e.g. Continue GCL or Start GCL. Bare application-roadmap Continue remains governed by CURRENT_WORK_POINTER.json.

tranches.name: GM Discovery & Recommendation Layer
tranches.maturity_requires: Representative records from multiple library families

tranches.name: Curated Starter Library & Proof Packs
tranches.note: Proof-pack assembly may grow incrementally throughout the program; final closure follows integrated representative coverage.

boundaries: GCL supplies reusable GM construction content/intelligence and does not replace CSW, Campaign/Scene/Session, Encounter Builder, AutoGM, D28 Adventure, A9 clues or future ISE/WCI authorities.
GCL templates are proposals/authoring material until explicitly incorporated by owning domains.
No universal Challenge Rating or guaranteed-balance claim.
Difficulty changes preserve independent pressure dimensions, provenance and uncertainty.
Adversary transformations may not invent unsupported mechanics/canon merely to meet desired difficulty.
Normal GM discovery is intent-first; giant undifferentiated list browsing is not the primary UX.
Every mature template supports ready-to-use and construction-material projections where applicable.
AI remains optional, proposal-only and authorization-filtered.
